unavailable: Choose an accessible item and destination.
busy: This item or its contents are needed by ongoing work.
stale: The item or destination changed. Refresh before moving it.
notPortable: This object cannot be moved by this action.
quantity: That quantity is unavailable or reserved.
packing: The bag does not have enough packing capacity.
depth: A bag cannot contain itself or exceed the nesting limit.
noPackingLoad: This item has no admitted packing load for a bag.
filledOpenBag: Keep an open basket with exposed materials directly carried or on supported ground.
